race.title: Kilberry Pub & Kitchen Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: CHARISMATIC KID is the one to beat on bumper form, and he may well make a winning start over hurdles. The main danger looks to be Willie Mullins' The Irish Avatar , who was useful in his own right in bumpers. OutofAfrika , Luxor Love and Confidence Within are others to note. CHARISMATIC KID (IRE) THE IRISH AVATAR (IRE) OUTOFAFRIKA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Charismatic Kid (10/11), The Irish Avatar (9/4), Outofafrika (4/1), Luxor Love (6/1), Apples Delight (25/1), Bonnie Gold (25/1), Confidence Within (25/1), Tidy Town (33/1), Spanish Agent (50/1), Rough And Tough (66/1), Churchroad Harry (66/1), Modern Day Hero (100/1), The Stags (100/1), War Rooms (100/1), Eamon's Dream (100/1), Parisian Dream (100/1), Walkwithmyfriend (100/1), Lady Cosmo (100/1), Crystal Yeats (100/1), Attack Or Defend (150/1), Jetaway Mountain (150/1), Awayoutback (200/1)
